en.why_it_matters: Listed chemicals can be diverted to chemical-weapons or illicit-drug production. Egypt is not a State Party to the Chemical Weapons Convention, so there is no Egyptian CWC national authority or CWC import/export declaration regime; exporters in CWC States Parties may refuse or restrict Schedule 2/3 transfers to Egypt. Narcotic precursors are controlled in Egypt under Law 182/1960 schedules, which the Ministry of Health and Population replaced in 2026.
ask_customer: Exact chemical name, CAS number, concentration and quantity; is it a mixture?
Stated end use and the end user's industrial activity (licensed factory? which production process?)
Is the substance on the Law 182/1960 schedules, the CWC schedules or the Australia Group list?
Has the foreign supplier received a pre-export notification (PEN) acknowledgement for precursors?
Storage site and Ministry of Environment / EEAA hazardous-substances licence, if hazardous
documents: Supplier Safety Data Sheet (SDS) and technical datasheet
Commercial invoice and packing list with CAS numbers and concentrations
End-user certificate / end-use statement signed by the importer

Import approval or permit from the competent authority (Egyptian Drug Authority / Ministry of Health for scheduled precursors; competent ministry under Environment Law 4/1994 Article 29 for hazardous substances)
Industrial licence / commercial register of the end user
Exporter's export licence where the exporting country requires one
en.egyptian_authority: Egyptian Drug Authority (EDA) / Ministry of Health and Population for substances in the Law 182/1960 schedules; Ministry of Environment / EEAA together with the competent sector ministry for hazardous substances (Law 4/1994 Art. 29); GOEIC and Customs at the border. No Egyptian CWC national authority (Egypt is not a CWC party).
red_flags: Quantity or concentration out of line with the customer's stated activity
Buyer is a trading company with no factory, laboratory or licence
Request to describe the chemical generically (for example 'industrial solvent') on the invoice
Shipment routed via third countries or free zones with no commercial reason
Cash payment or payment by unrelated third parties
Customer refuses to give an end-use statement or SDS
Combinations of precursors that together enable a weapon or drug synthesis route

ar.why_it_matters: قد يتم تحويل المواد الكيميائية المدرجة إلى إنتاج أسلحة كيميائية أو مواد مخدرة. مصر ليست دولة طرفاً في اتفاقية حظر الأسلحة الكيميائية، ومن ثم لا توجد هيئة وطنية مصرية للاتفاقية ولا نظام إعلانات استيراد وتصدير وفقاً لها، وقد يرفض المصدرون في الدول الأطراف تصدير مواد الجدولين الثاني والثالث إلى مصر أو يقيدونه. وتخضع سلائف المخدرات في مصر لجداول القانون رقم 182 لسنة 1960، والتي استبدلتها وزارة الصحة والسكان في عام 2026.

en.why_it_matters: Ammonium nitrate, chlorates, perchlorates, nitric acid, hydrogen peroxide, nitromethane and metal powders are used in improvised explosive devices. In Egypt, making, possessing or importing explosives or 'what is treated as explosives' without a licence is a serious offence under Penal Code Art. 102(a), and the Minister of Interior defines which materials count. After the 2020 Beirut blast, the Ministry of Environment ordered inspections of ammonium nitrate producers and the government reviewed dangerous goods held in ports.
ask_customer: Substance, CAS number, concentration (for ammonium nitrate: nitrogen % by weight) and grade (fertiliser, technical or explosive grade)
Agricultural or industrial end use; is the customer a licensed fertiliser distributor, farm, mine or quarry?
Storage location and conditions; Civil Protection / Environment compliance
Is the material on the Minister of Interior list of explosive-related materials, and is there an import or possession licence?
Packaging (bags or bulk), transport route and transit ports
documents: SDS and certificate of analysis showing concentration / nitrogen content
End-use and end-user statement
Ministry of Interior licence for explosives or controlled materials, where applicable
Ministry of Agriculture fertiliser registration or approval for fertiliser imports (authority not confirmed; verify)
Mining or quarry licence for blasting agents
IMDG dangerous-goods declaration for sea shipments
en.egyptian_authority: Ministry of Interior (licensing of explosives and materials treated as explosives: Penal Code Art. 102(a); the Minister's list was reported as Decision 18722/2004, secondary source only); Ministry of Environment / EEAA (hazardous substances, Law 4/1994); Ministry of Agriculture for fertilisers (specific legal basis not found); Ministry of Trade and Industry (export duty on nitrogen fertilisers). No Egyptian list with EU-style concentration limits was found, so apply EU Regulation 2019/1148 as international practice.
red_flags: Ammonium nitrate of 16% nitrogen or more, or chlorates/perchlorates of 40% or more, sold to a non-agricultural or non-industrial buyer
Small, repeated purchases or split orders
Request for unusual purity or concentration for the stated use
Customer unfamiliar with agronomy or the product's use
Combined orders of an oxidiser and fuel or metal powder (for example ammonium nitrate with aluminium powder)
Refusal of delivery to a registered site; request for pick-up in cash
Long port dwell or abandoned dangerous cargo

ar.why_it_matters: تُستخدم نترات الأمونيوم والكلورات والبيركلورات وحمض النيتريك وفوق أكسيد الهيدروجين والنيتروميثان والمساحيق المعدنية في تصنيع العبوات المتفجرة. وفي مصر يُعد إحراز المفرقعات أو ما في حكمها أو حيازتها أو استيرادها أو صنعها دون ترخيص جريمة جسيمة وفقاً للمادة 102 (أ) من قانون العقوبات، ويحدد وزير الداخلية المواد التي تُعتبر في حكم المفرقعات. وعقب انفجار بيروت عام 2020 وجهت وزارة البيئة بالتفتيش على منشآت إنتاج نترات الأمونيوم، وراجعت الحكومة المواد الخطرة الراكدة بالموانئ.

en.why_it_matters: Under Law 7/2010, importing, clearing through customs, exporting or transporting any radioactive material, source or component needs prior approval from the Egyptian Nuclear and Radiological Regulatory Authority (ENRRA). Parliament reinforced this in a March 2026 amendment to Article 55; medical X-ray machines are exempt from that approval. Egypt is an NPT party with IAEA safeguards but has not signed the Additional Protocol, so foreign suppliers often apply extra scrutiny to Egypt.
ask_customer: Isotope, activity (Bq or Ci), sealed or unsealed source, IAEA source category
Facility licence number issued by ENRRA and the authorised user
Intended application (medical, industrial radiography, well logging, research)
Return or disposal arrangement for disused sources
For equipment (for example 2B225 manipulators or 3A228 triggered spark gaps): technical specifications and why that performance level is needed
documents: ENRRA prior approval or permit for import, export or transport
ENRRA facility or practice licence of the end user
Source certificate and technical datasheet
End-user certificate with non-proliferation and no-re-export assurances
Exporter's nuclear or dual-use export licence (NSG Part 1/Part 2 items)
Transport documents meeting IAEA transport rules (class 7 dangerous goods)
en.egyptian_authority: Egyptian Nuclear and Radiological Regulatory Authority (ENRRA), under Law 7/2010 and its Executive Regulations (PM Decree 1326/2011).
red_flags: Activity level or number of sources out of line with the facility's licence

ar.why_it_matters: وفقاً للقانون رقم 7 لسنة 2010، يشترط استيراد أي مواد أو مصادر أو مكونات مشعة أو الإفراج الجمركي عنها أو تصديرها أو نقلها الحصول على موافقة مسبقة من هيئة الرقابة النووية والإشعاعية. وقد عزز مجلس النواب ذلك بتعديل المادة 55 في مارس 2026، مع استثناء أجهزة الأشعة السينية الطبية من هذه الموافقة. ومصر طرف في معاهدة عدم الانتشار وتخضع لضمانات الوكالة الدولية للطاقة الذرية، إلا أنها لم توقع البروتوكول الإضافي، ولذلك كثيراً ما يطبق الموردون الأجانب تدقيقاً إضافياً على الشحنات المتجهة إلى مصر.

en.why_it_matters: Telecom Regulation Law 10/2003 Art. 44, as amended in 2022, bans importing, manufacturing, assembling, possessing, using, operating, installing or marketing telecom equipment without an NTRA permit. For equipment on a list set by the Minister of Defence, NTRA also needs the consent of the Armed Forces and national security bodies. Under Art. 64, using encryption equipment needs written consent. Under Ministry of Trade and Industry rules, tracking, GPS and surveillance equipment needs security approval, and covert recorders disguised as pens or watches are banned imports. Intrusion and interception tools (5A001.j, 4A005, 4D004) are high-risk human-rights items too.
ask_customer: Make, model, frequency bands, output power and encryption functionality (algorithm, key length, mass-market status)
Does the item have an NTRA type-approval certificate? Which scheme (light, intermediate or tight)?
Is the item on the Minister of Defence list needing Armed Forces / national security consent?
End user: licensed operator, government body, private company? Network or deployment location
Does the item provide interception, lawful-intercept, monitoring, IMSI-catcher or tracking capability?
documents: NTRA type-approval certificate and NTRA import permit (Law 10/2003 Art. 44)
Written approval for encryption equipment (Art. 64) and security approval where required
Technical datasheet, operating description and encryption classification (for example the US 5A992 / 740.17 self-classification or EU Annex I Cat. 5 Part 2 note 3)
End-user certificate stating no re-export and no use for unlawful surveillance
Exporter's licence or licence-exception determination
en.egyptian_authority: National Telecom Regulatory Authority (NTRA), with Armed Forces and national security consent for listed equipment (Law 10/2003 Arts. 44 and 64); security authorities' approval for tracking, GPS and surveillance equipment (Ministry of Trade and Industry restricted-import rules).
red_flags: Network or interception equipment ordered by a buyer with no operator licence
Request to remove or disable encryption markings, or to split shipments to avoid type approval
Satellite or long-range radio equipment for undefined use
Military-grade or government-grade encryption for a private buyer

ar.why_it_matters: تحظر المادة 44 من قانون تنظيم الاتصالات رقم 10 لسنة 2003، بعد تعديلها في 2022، استيراد أجهزة ومعدات الاتصالات أو تصنيعها أو تجميعها أو حيازتها أو استخدامها أو تشغيلها أو تركيبها أو تسويقها دون تصريح من الجهاز القومي لتنظيم الاتصالات. وبالنسبة للمعدات المدرجة بقائمة يحددها وزير الدفاع، يلزم الجهاز الحصول على موافقة القوات المسلحة وأجهزة الأمن القومي أيضاً. وتشترط المادة 64 موافقة كتابية لاستخدام أجهزة التشفير. ووفقاً لقواعد وزارة التجارة والصناعة، تخضع أجهزة التتبع وتحديد المواقع والمراقبة لموافقة الجهات الأمنية، ويُحظر استيراد أجهزة التسجيل المموهة في صورة أقلام أو ساعات. كما تُعد أدوات الاختراق والاعتراض (5A001.j و4A005 و4D004) عالية المخاطر من منظور حقوق الإنسان.

en.why_it_matters: Maraging steel, high-strength aluminium and titanium alloys, carbon fibre, tungsten, zirconium, beryllium and fine metal powders are used in centrifuges, missile structures, propellants and armour. They are often ordered in forms (tubes, rods, prepregs) that reveal their intended use. No Egyptian-specific control was found. EU 2019/1148 Annex II covers aluminium and magnesium powders below 200 µm at 70% w/w or more as reportable explosives precursors.

en.why_it_matters: Under Law 394/1954 (as amended), importing, trading in, manufacturing or repairing weapons and ammunition needs a special licence from the Minister of Interior. Firearms imports also need Ministry of Defence approval, which also sets quantities (a 2014 amendment). Unlicensed import carries life imprisonment, or death if done for terrorist purposes. Bladed weapons need prior security approval, and camouflage fabrics and toy guns firing solid projectiles are banned imports. Banks should treat military-list items as outside normal trade-finance appetite unless the end user is a state body with documented approvals.

ar.why_it_matters: وفقاً للقانون رقم 394 لسنة 1954 وتعديلاته، يشترط استيراد الأسلحة والذخائر أو الاتجار فيها أو صنعها أو إصلاحها الحصول على ترخيص خاص من وزير الداخلية. كما يستلزم استيراد الأسلحة النارية موافقة وزارة الدفاع التي تحدد الكميات أيضاً (تعديل 2014). ويُعاقب على الاستيراد بغير ترخيص بالسجن المؤبد، أو بالإعدام إذا ارتُكب لغرض إرهابي. وتخضع الأسلحة البيضاء لموافقة أمنية مسبقة، ويُحظر استيراد الأقمشة المموهة وألعاب الأطفال التي تطلق مقذوفات صلبة. وينبغي للبنوك اعتبار بنود القوائم العسكرية خارج نطاق شهية مخاطر تمويل التجارة المعتادة، ما لم يكن المستخدم النهائي جهة حكومية وبحوزتها موافقات موثقة.

en.why_it_matters: EMLCU Decision 1/2024 binds Egyptian financial institutions and DNFBPs. They must check UN Security Council lists daily, freeze the funds of listed persons and entities without delay or prior notice, screen all parties to a transaction before dealing, and report immediately to their supervisor and EMLCU. It covers terrorism and WMD-proliferation regimes (1267/1989/2253, 1988, 1718 on DPRK, 2231 on Iran). Vessels named in UN 1718 designations are a direct TFS exposure for shipping finance. No published CBE instruction specific to vessel screening was found.
